plan.task_instruction: Build SplitFair, an accessible local Mini App for splitting a bill. Let users enter a dollar amount and number of people, then calculate whole-cent shares that add up exactly to the total. Keep allocateShares in split.mjs, validate invalid input, show each person's share, make Reset clear the results, and add visible tests.
acceptance: The interface is accessible and works locally as a Mini App.
Valid amounts and party sizes produce per-person whole-cent shares whose sum exactly equals the entered total.
Reset clears calculated shares and results.
Visible tests cover the share calculation and relevant validation/reset behavior.
